name: GrandPrint.app - tiled poster maker
description: Turn one image or PDF page into a large tiled print. Runs entirely on your device — no upload, no account, no watermark.
author: Parsa F.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'
